name: cricket-conscience
description: Candid ordinary-chat response review for semantic fidelity, evidence, authority boundaries, and behavioral overreach.

interface.longDescription: Cricket is a candid response-review discipline for ChatGPT and Codex. It checks semantic fidelity, unsupported certainty, authority drift, completion claims, and behavioral overreach; it preserves the user's literal proposition and stays silent on clean passes. Cricket is a reviewer, not an independent evidence source or effect authority. In ordinary Chat, skill activation is relevance-based rather than a platform-enforced lifecycle hook.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this reasoning strengthens or changes the original claim.
Challenge the weakest material assumption in this answer.

publication.release_notes: Initial public skills-only release of Cricket Conscience: bounded response review for semantic fidelity, evidence calibration, authority boundaries, anti-Righter proposition preservation, and behavioral overreach.
